author: SickProdigy
description: Manage native Discord scheduled events and reminders with optional per-server Google Calendar access.
end_user_data_statement: Google stores calendar events. This cog stores per-server calendar settings and minimal Discord user IDs associated with events created through the bot.
install_msg: Use `[p]calendar` for native Discord events and `[p]calendarset reminderchannel` for reminders. Google Calendar is optional; use `[p]calendarset serviceaccount` when linking it.
name: CalendarEvents
short: Native Discord events and reminders with optional Google Calendar access.
